q: Gopuff 题目的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core functional requirements are in scope for the Gopuff design? (Select all)
options: 按用户位置查询 1 小时内可送达商品的有效库存
允许用户一次下单多个商品
首版实现支付、司机路径规划和退货
首版只关注 availability 和 ordering
why: 本题只保留附近 DC 库存聚合和下单不超卖：库存行数 = 10k DC × 100k item；支付、配送、搜索、退货划到线下范围。
why_en: The core scope is local availability aggregation and multi-item ordering without double booking, not payments, routing, or returns.
optionExplanations: 对。这是核心读需求：按位置聚合 1 小时可达的库存。
对。多商品下单是核心写需求，直接决定事务要覆盖多行库存。
错。这些明确写进「线下范围」，首版故意不做。
对。范围声明本身就是需求，划清边界避免过度设计。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - this is the core read requirement: aggregate one-hour-reachable stock by location.
Correct - multi-item ordering is a core write requirement that shapes the transaction.
Wrong - these are explicitly out of scope for the first version.
Correct - stating scope is itself a requirement that keeps the design focused.
options_en: Query the effective available stock, deliverable within one hour, by the user's location.
Let a user order multiple items in a single purchase.
Build payments, driver routing, and returns in the first version.
Scope the first version to availability and ordering only.

termDefinitions.meaning: 存放库存的微型配送仓，用户附近的实物库存来源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distribution center (DC) is a micro-warehouse that stores physical inventory near users.

scenario: 面试只有 45 分钟设计 Gopuff 即时零售：10k 个 DC 分散存货，承诺 1 小时送达。
scenario_en: You have 45 minutes to design Gopuff instant retail: stock spread across 10,000 distribution centers with a one-hour delivery promise.

q: Gopuff 系统的关键非功能需求有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which non-functional requirements matter most for this Gopuff system? (Select all)
options: availability 查询小于 100ms
下单强一致，不能两个用户买到同一件实物
支持约 10k 个 DC 和 100k 个 catalog item
允许库存扣减最终一致且可超卖
why: 读路径要快，写路径要强一致，规模锚点是 10k DC、100k item 和千万级订单/天。
why_en: The design must make availability reads fast, orders strongly consistent, and scale to thousands of distribution centers and catalog items.
optionExplanations: 对。读路径要快才能支撑类似搜索的体验。
对。防超卖是本题最硬的一致性要求。
对。这两个数字是分区和索引设计的规模锚点。
错。文章明确要求强一致防超卖，不能接受超卖。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - fast reads are needed to support search-like use cases.
Correct - preventing overselling is the hardest consistency requirement here.
Correct - these two numbers anchor the partitioning and indexing design.
Wrong - the article requires strong consistency precisely to prevent overselling.
options_en: Availability queries should respond in under 100 milliseconds.
Ordering must be strongly consistent so two customers can never buy the same physical item.
The system should support roughly 10,000 distribution centers and 100,000 catalog items.
Inventory decrements can be eventually consistent and allow overselling.
scenario: Gopuff 即时零售：浏览量远大于下单量，读要快；同一件实物只有一份，两人不能同时买走。
scenario_en: In Gopuff instant retail, browsing far outnumbers orders so reads must be fast, while one physical unit can never be sold to two people.

q: Item 和 Inventory 在这题里的核心区别是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference between Item and Inventory in this design?
options: 两者完全相同，只是数据库里的表命名不同
Item 是目录商品类型，Inventory 是 DC 实物
Item 只能被下单，Inventory 只能被搜索
Item 存地理位置，Inventory 存用户资料
why: 用户看到的是商品类型，比如 Cheetos；系统防超卖时关心的是具体 DC 里可扣减的实物库存。
why_en: Item is the catalog concept customers see, while Inventory is the physical stock at a specific distribution center.
optionExplanations: 错。两者语义完全不同，不是同义词。
对。用户看到的是商品类型；防超卖关心的是具体 DC 里的实物。
错。这里把下单和搜索的角色分反了，两个实体都不是这样限定的。
错。地理位置属于 DistributionCenter，用户资料不属于这两个实体。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - the two concepts are not synonyms at all.
Correct - customers see the item type, while oversell prevention cares about physical stock at a DC.
Wrong - this swaps the roles; neither entity is restricted that way.
Wrong - location belongs to DistributionCenter, and neither entity stores user profiles.
tradeoff: 目录概念 Item vs 物理库存 Inventory
options_en: The two are identical, just different table names in the database.
Item is the catalog product type; Inventory is physical stock at a DC.
Item can only be ordered, and Inventory can only be searched.
Item stores geographic location, and Inventory stores user profiles.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某个 DC 中一件商品的实物库存记录。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Inventory is the record of physical stock for one item at a specific distribution center.

scenario: Gopuff 目录里有 100k 种商品，同一种 Cheetos 分散在 10k 个 DC，下单必须扣到某个 DC 的实物。
scenario_en: Gopuff has 100k catalog products, the same Cheetos sits in 10,000 DCs, and an order must decrement real stock at one specific DC.

q: Gopuff 设计中的核心实体有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core entities belong in the Gopuff design? (Select all)
options: Inventory：某 DC 中的实物库存
Item：用户看到的商品类型
DistributionCenter：库存所在的物理仓点
Order：一次用户下单及其包含的库存项
why: 这四个实体分别支撑库存聚合、目录展示、地理可送达判断和下单记录；库存行数 = DC 数 × item 数。
why_en: Inventory, Item, DistributionCenter, and Order cover the physical stock, catalog view, geography, and purchase record.
optionExplanations: 对。这是防超卖判断真正依赖的实体。
对。这是客户端展示和下单请求引用的实体。
对。它承载地理位置，决定谁能在 1 小时内送达。
对。它把多件库存和一次购买绑定成一条记录。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - this is the entity oversell checks actually depend on.
Correct - clients reference this entity for display and ordering.
Correct - it carries the location that decides one-hour deliverability.
Correct - it binds multiple inventory rows to a single purchase.
options_en: Inventory: the physical stock of an item held at one distribution center.
Item: the catalog-level product type customers see.
DistributionCenter: the physical warehouse where inventory lives.
Order: one purchase and the inventory items it includes.
scenario: Gopuff 要按用户位置聚合附近 DC 的库存，并在一个事务里原子下单不超卖。
scenario_en: Gopuff aggregates stock across nearby DCs by user location and must place orders atomically without overselling.

scenario: 客户端要按经纬度查询当前位置 1 小时内可送达的商品库存，并避免一次返回过多数据。
scenario_en: The client queries stock deliverable within one hour by latitude and longitude, with pagination to keep responses bounded.
q: 最贴合 availability 查询的 API 是？
q_en: Which API best fits the availability query?
options: POST /drivers/{driverId}/route?refresh=true&window=1h
DELETE /inventory/{dcId}/items/{itemId}?confirm=true
GET /availability?lat={lat}&lng={lng}&page={p}&limit={n}
GET /payments/{orderId}?include=receipt&expand=items
why: availability API 的输入是用户位置和分页参数，输出是附近 DC 库存聚合后的商品可用量。
why_en: The availability API needs location and pagination because it returns the union of stock from nearby distribution centers.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目包含搜索排序，另加 catalog/search API 会更合适，但本文把搜索放在线下范围。
optionExplanations: 错。这是配送路径规划，不是查询可用库存。
错。这是危险的写操作，与只读查询需求无关。
对。位置定位附近 DC，分页避免一次吐出过多商品。
错。支付详情和 availability 查询完全是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - this plans driver routes, not availability.
Wrong - this is a destructive write, unrelated to a read-only query.
Correct - location finds nearby DCs, and pagination avoids returning too much data at once.
Wrong - payment detail lookup has nothing to do with checking availability.
tradeoff: 分页只读查询 vs 一次性返回全部库存
options_en: POST to refresh a driver route for a one-hour window.
DELETE to wipe out one item of a DC inventory.
GET /availability with lat, lng, page, and limit query parameters.
GET a payment receipt with its line items expanded.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 page 和 limit 参数分批返回结果，避免一次响应过大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pagination returns results in pages using parameters like page and limit so a single response stays small.

scenario: 用户一次购买多个商品，后端需要再次确认这些商品在 1 小时可送达范围内且不会超卖。
scenario_en: A user buys multiple items at once, and the backend must recheck one-hour deliverability and prevent overselling.
q: 下单 API 应该包含什么关键信息？
q_en: What key information should the order API carry?
options: 客户端自己传来的库存锁 ID 和扣减数量
支付网关的内部私钥和商户密钥
商品发布方的 RSS 订阅地址
商品列表和用户位置，身份从会话取
why: Orders Service 必须用位置重新找可服务 DC 并在事务里扣库存，用户身份应来自认证上下文而不是客户端伪造字段。
why_en: The order API carries items and location while identity comes from the authenticated context, and the service rechecks local stock transactionally.
whenOtherWins: 如果已经有服务端购物车或 reservation，可只传 cart/reservation id，但仍要在后端校验库存。
optionExplanations: 错。客户端不该自己造锁 ID，库存检查必须在服务端重新做。
错。私钥不该出现在订单请求体里，这是安全事故。
错。RSS 地址和下单毫无关系，纯粹的干扰项。
对。位置用来重新核对可服务 DC，身份来自认证上下文而非客户端字段。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - clients should not invent lock IDs; the server must recheck stock itself.
Wrong - a private key has no place in an order request body; that is a security incident.
Wrong - an RSS URL is unrelated to placing an order.
Correct - location rechecks serviceable DCs, and identity comes from the session, not a client field.
tradeoff: 服务端重新校验位置和身份 vs 信任客户端传来的状态
options_en: An inventory lock ID and decrement count supplied by the client.
The payment gateway private key and merchant secret.
The product publisher RSS feed URL.
The item list and location, with identity taken from the session.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务端保存的登录状态，用来确认请求方身份而不依赖客户端自报。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A session is server-held login state used to confirm identity instead of trusting client-supplied fields.

q: 把 availability 查询路径按正确顺序排列：
q_en: Put the availability query path in the right order.
steps: 用这些 DC ID 查询库存并按 Item 聚合数量
Availability Service 接收用户位置和过滤条件
Nearby Service 返回 1 小时内可服务的 DC 列表
Availability Service 调用 Nearby Service
why: 先把地理问题缩小到附近 DC，再只在这些 DC 的库存上做聚合。
why_en: Availability first narrows geography to serviceable distribution centers, then aggregates inventory only from those centers.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] --> Avail[Availability Service]
Avail --> Nearby[Nearby Service]
Nearby --> DCs[Nearby DCs]
Avail --> Inv[(Inventory DB)]
Inv --> Result[Available items]

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据用户经纬度返回 1 小时内可送达 DC 列表的内部服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Nearby Service returns the list of distribution centers that can deliver to a location within one hour.

scenario: Availability Service 和 Orders Service 都需要判断哪些 DC 能在 1 小时内送达用户位置。
scenario_en: Both Availability Service and Orders Service need to decide which DCs can deliver to a user within one hour.
q: 这段逻辑最好放在哪里？
q_en: Where should this serviceability logic live?
options: 共享 Nearby Service
各客户端自己算可送达 DC 集合
内嵌进 Orders Service 里各写一份
固定绑定用户最近的一个 DC
why: Nearby Service 复用地理和行车时间逻辑，让 availability 和 order 在同一可服务范围上做判断。
why_en: A shared Nearby Service centralizes serviceability logic so reads and orders use the same delivery-area decision.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是一个单体小系统，可以先做成内部模块，但抽象边界仍是附近 DC 查询。
optionExplanations: 对。两条读写路径共用同一次「谁能送达」的判断结果。
错。客户端各自算容易和后端结果不一致，也重复造轮子。
错。两个服务各实现一遍，半径和行车时间口径迟早漂移。
错。固定单个 DC 完全忽略了行车时间和多仓库存分布。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - both read and write paths share one serviceability decision.
Wrong - client-side computation risks disagreeing with the backend and duplicates logic.
Wrong - two separate copies will drift on radius and travel-time rules.
Wrong - a fixed single DC ignores travel time and the multi-warehouse layout entirely.
tradeoff: 共享服务复用地理逻辑 vs 各服务各自实现
options_en: Put it in a shared Nearby Service.
Let each client compute its own set of serviceable DCs.
Inline a separate copy of the logic inside each service.
Always bind the user to the single closest DC.

termDefinitions.meaning: 判断哪些 DC 能在 1 小时内送达用户位置的共享服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shared service that determines which distribution centers can deliver to a location within one hour.

q: 只用欧氏距离或 Haversine 距离筛 DC，主要问题是什么？
q_en: What is the main problem with using only Euclidean or Haversine distance to filter DCs?
options: 完全无法计算用户和 DC 之间的经纬度距离
忽略道路、河流和实时交通，1 小时送达可能落空
会自动把所有候选 DC 的库存全部锁定
查询结果只能返回一个商品，无法聚合多个
why: 直线距离只能粗筛，真实送达时间取决于道路网络和交通。
why_en: Straight-line distance is only a rough filter because real delivery time depends on roads, barriers, and traffic.
optionExplanations: 错。经纬度计算本身没问题，Haversine 公式算得出直线距离。
对。直线距离忽略路网和拥堵，可能把开车 90 分钟的 DC 误判成可达。
错。库存锁定属于下单路径，跟距离筛选完全无关。
错。这是聚合返回问题，和距离算法选择无关。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - lat/long math is fine; the Haversine formula correctly computes straight-line distance.
Correct - straight-line distance ignores roads and traffic, so a 90-minute drive can look reachable.
Wrong - inventory locking belongs to the order path, unrelated to distance filtering.
Wrong - this is an unrelated claim about result aggregation, not distance algorithms.
options_en: It cannot compute the lat/long distance between user and DC at all.
It ignores roads, rivers, and live traffic, so the one-hour promise can fail.
It automatically locks all inventory at every candidate DC.
The query can only return a single item and never an aggregate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 考虑地球曲率计算两经纬度间直线距离的公式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Haversine formula computes the straight-line distance between two latitude/longitude points accounting for Earth's curvature.

scenario: Gopuff 承诺 1 小时送达，要从 10k 个 DC 里筛出真正能按时开到用户手上的那几个。
scenario_en: Gopuff promises delivery within an hour, so it must pick from 10,000 DCs the few that can actually drive there in time.

scenario: 需求明确是 1 小时内送达，直线距离在城市、河流或交通拥堵场景下误差很大。
scenario_en: The requirement is one-hour delivery, and straight-line distance can be very wrong around cities, rivers, or traffic.
q: 更准确的 Nearby 判断应该引入什么？
q_en: What should Nearby use for a more accurate serviceability decision?
options: 库存表里那一行记录的自增主键 ID
Redis 里某个缓存条目的 TTL 过期设置
外部或内部 Travel Time Service
订单当前的支付状态字段和结果
why: 行车时间服务能用路网和交通估计 DC 到用户位置的真实耗时，更贴合 1 小时送达。
why_en: A travel-time service estimates actual driving duration using road and traffic data, matching the one-hour requirement.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是粗略展示附近门店，直线距离或 Haversine 可能足够便宜。
optionExplanations: 错。自增 ID 只是行号，和送达时间毫无关系。
错。TTL 控制缓存过期，不衡量行车时间。
对。行车时间服务能用路网和交通数据估计真实耗时。
错。支付状态发生在下单之后，和判断能否 1 小时送达无关。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - an auto-increment ID is just a row number, unrelated to delivery time.
Wrong - TTL controls cache expiry, not driving duration.
Correct - a travel-time service estimates real duration using road and traffic data.
Wrong - payment status happens after ordering, unrelated to one-hour reachability.
tradeoff: 真实行车时间估计 vs 便宜但粗糙的直线距离
options_en: The auto-increment primary key of an inventory row.
A Redis cache entry's TTL expiration setting.
An external or internal travel-time service.
The order's current payment-status field.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用路网和交通信息估算从 DC 到用户位置实际行车时间的服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A travel-time service estimates actual driving duration from a DC to a location using road and traffic data.

scenario: 系统有 10k 个 DC，不能每次用户查询都对每个 DC 调用一次外部行车时间服务。
scenario_en: The system has about 10,000 DCs, so each user query cannot call an external travel-time service for every DC.
q: 合理优化是什么？
q_en: What is the reasonable optimization?
options: 对全部 1 万个 DC 都串行调用行车时间服务
完全忽略用户位置，返回全国所有 DC 的库存
不筛候选，把每件商品的库存推给所有 DC
先用 60 英里半径粗筛，再对候选算行车时间
why: 半径粗筛先排除不可能 1 小时送达的 DC，再把昂贵的行车时间调用限制在小候选集内。
why_en: Radius pruning limits expensive travel-time calls to plausible nearby distribution centers.
whenOtherWins: 如果 DC 数量只有个位数，全量调用行车时间服务也能接受。
optionExplanations: 错。对 1 万个 DC 都调用外部服务，延迟和成本都不可接受。
错。忽略位置直接违反 1 小时可送达这条核心需求。
错。这是订单/库存分发问题，不是筛选候选 DC 的方法。
对。半径粗筛先排除明显送不到的 DC，把昂贵调用限制在小候选集。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - calling an external service for 10,000 DCs is far too slow and expensive.
Wrong - ignoring location breaks the core one-hour deliverability requirement.
Wrong - this is about distributing inventory, not narrowing candidate DCs.
Correct - radius pruning removes obviously unreachable DCs before the expensive call.
tradeoff: 先地理粗筛再精算 vs 对全部 DC 都调用精确服务
options_en: Serially call the travel-time service for all 10,000 DCs.
Ignore the user location and return stock from every DC nationwide.
Skip filtering and push every item stock record to all DCs.
Prune with a 60-mile radius first, then compute travel time for the survivors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用路网和交通信息估算行车时间的外部/内部服务，调用它有延迟和成本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A travel-time service estimates driving duration using road and traffic data, and each call costs latency and money.

q: 按附近 DC 查询商品可用量时，为什么是取库存 union 而不是 intersection？
q_en: When querying nearby DC stock, why use a union rather than an intersection?
options: 用户只需要附近任一可服务 DC 能提供商品即可
每个商品必须所有附近 DC 都有货
intersection 更容易防超卖
union 只能用于支付
why: 有效可用量是所有可服务 DC 库存的总和，用户不关心某个商品是否每个 DC 都有。
why_en: Effective availability is the sum across serviceable distribution centers because any one of them can fulfill the item.
optionExplanations: 对。只要附近任意一个可服务仓有货，用户就能下单。
错。这是把 union 和 intersection 的语义弄反了。
错。防超卖靠的是下单时的事务扣减，不是 union/intersection 的选择。
错。union 是聚合可用库存的方式，和支付流程无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - if any one nearby serviceable warehouse has stock, the user can order.
Wrong - this reverses what union versus intersection actually means here.
Wrong - oversell prevention comes from the order-time transaction, not this choice.
Wrong - union is how availability is aggregated, unrelated to payments.
tradeoff: 跨可服务 DC 求 union（任一有货即可） vs 求 intersection（每个 DC 都要有货）
options_en: The user only needs any one nearby serviceable DC to carry the item.
Every nearby DC must carry the item for it to count.
Intersection makes oversell prevention easier.
Union can only be used for payments.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把多个可服务 DC 的库存加总，而不是要求每个 DC 都有货。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Union sums stock across multiple serviceable DCs instead of requiring every DC to have it.

scenario: 用户附近有 3 个可 1 小时送达的 DC，Cheetos 只在其中两个有货，要给用户展示可买数量。
scenario_en: Three DCs can reach the user within an hour, Cheetos is stocked at only two of them, and we must show a buyable quantity.

scenario: Availability Service 已拿到附近 DC 列表，需要返回商品名称、描述和可用数量。
scenario_en: Availability Service already has the nearby DC list and must return item names, descriptions, and available quantities.
q: 首版最直接的数据访问方式是什么？
q_en: What is the most direct first-version data access pattern?
options: 让客户端对每个候选 DC 分别单独发起库存请求
join 库存与商品两表后按 item 聚合
扫描对象存储桶里保存的商品图片文件名
把订单历史表直接当成当前可售库存来查询
why: 库存和商品目录都在同一个关系库时，join 后聚合是最简单的首版实现。
why_en: With inventory and catalog in one relational database, a join plus aggregation is the simplest first implementation.
whenOtherWins: 如果 catalog 搜索和展示复杂度提高，catalog 可拆到独立服务和搜索索引中。
optionExplanations: 错。客户端逐个 DC 请求既慢又把聚合逻辑错误地放到了前端。
对。库存和目录同库时，一次 join 加聚合就是最简单的首版实现。
错。图片文件名不是库存数量，这里混淆了媒体存储和数据查询。
错。订单表记录的是已购买的商品，不是当前可售库存。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - per-DC client requests are slow and wrongly push aggregation to the frontend.
Correct - with inventory and catalog in one DB, a join plus aggregation is the simplest first cut.
Wrong - image filenames are not stock counts; this confuses media storage with data queries.
Wrong - the orders table records what was already purchased, not current sellable stock.
tradeoff: 首版单库 join 聚合 vs 拆分 catalog/search 独立服务
options_en: Have the client fire a separate stock request per candidate DC.
Join the inventory and item tables, then aggregate by item.
Scan an object-storage bucket for saved product image filenames.
Treat the order-history table as if it were current sellable stock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按外键把 Inventory 和 Item 两张表的行关联起来，一次查询拿到商品名和数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A join combines rows from the Inventory and Item tables by a shared key so one query returns both name and quantity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的关系型数据库，支持事务和强一致写入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Postgres is a relational database that supports transactions and strongly consistent writes.

q: 真实电商为什么常把 Catalog 和 Inventory 拆成两套存储？
q_en: Why do real e-commerce systems usually split Catalog and Inventory into separate stores?
options: Catalog 只能存在 Redis，Inventory 只能存在 S3
Catalog 不需要任何 API
Catalog 面向搜索展示，Inventory 面向实时数量和扣减，工作负载不同
Inventory 不能被数据库保存
why: 商品描述、搜索排序和库存扣减的访问模式不同，生产系统常按职责拆分；本题首版合并是为了简化。
why_en: Catalog and inventory often split because search/display workloads differ from stock-count and reservation workloads.
optionExplanations: 错。文中没有这种存储位置限制，这是编造的约束。
错。目录浏览显然需要读 API，这个说法明显不成立。
对。搜索排序是读多且可容忍旧数据，扣减库存要强一致，职责天然不同。
错。本题恰恰把 Inventory 存在 Postgres 里。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - the article names no such storage restriction; this is a fabricated constraint.
Wrong - browsing a catalog obviously needs a read API.
Correct - search/display tolerates staleness while stock decrement needs strong consistency.
Wrong - this design stores Inventory in Postgres.
tradeoff: 按访问模式拆分 catalog/inventory vs 首版合并简化
options_en: Catalog can only live in Redis, and Inventory can only live in S3.
Catalog does not need any API.
Catalog serves search and display, while Inventory serves real-time counts and decrements - the workloads differ.
Inventory cannot be stored in a database.
scenario: 生产电商每天百万级搜索排序读，同时有高频库存扣减写，两类负载共用一张表会互相拖累。
scenario_en: Production e-commerce runs millions of search and ranking reads a day alongside high-frequency stock decrements, and one shared table makes them fight.

q: 把用户查询 A/B/C 商品 availability 的路径排好序：
q_en: Put the availability path for items A, B, and C in the right order.
steps: 把商品 A/B/C 在这些 DC 的库存按 item 求和
用户请求 Availability Service 并传位置
返回每个 item 的有效可用数量
Nearby Service 返回可服务 DC IDs
why: 位置先转成可服务 DC 集合，然后库存查询只在该集合内聚合。
why_en: The request converts location into serviceable centers, aggregates stock for requested items, and returns effective quantities.
diagram:
flowchart TD
Cart[Items A B C] --> Nearby[Find nearby DCs]
Nearby --> Query[Query inventory by DC]
Query --> Union[Union available stock]
Union --> Response[Availability response]

scenario: 两个用户几乎同时购买同一个 DC 里的最后一件商品，系统绝不能让两个订单都成功。
scenario_en: Two users almost simultaneously buy the last unit in the same DC, and the system must not let both orders succeed.
q: 下单路径最重要的设计目标是什么？
q_en: What is the most important design goal for the order path?
options: 读请求越旧越好
每次下单都异步延迟一天
只更新缓存不更新数据库
强一致的库存检查和扣减
why: 下单是防超卖路径，必须把检查库存、创建订单和扣减库存放进同一个一致性边界。
why_en: Ordering must strongly couple stock checking, order creation, and inventory decrement to prevent overselling.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是展示 availability，短暂旧数据可以接受，读路径可以走缓存或副本。
optionExplanations: 错。下单路径追求正确性，不是刻意用旧数据。
错。人为延迟一天不解决并发抢购的一致性问题。
错。只改缓存意味着数据库库存和事实脱节，最终必然超卖。
对。检查、创建订单、扣库存必须在同一致性边界内完成。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - the order path optimizes for correctness, not deliberately stale reads.
Wrong - an artificial one-day delay does not solve concurrent-purchase consistency.
Wrong - updating only the cache leaves the database out of sync, guaranteeing overselling.
Correct - checking, creating the order, and decrementing stock must happen in one boundary.
tradeoff: 强一致检查+扣减 vs 更快但可能超卖的宽松路径
options_en: The staler the read, the better.
Delay every order asynchronously by a day.
Only update the cache, never the database.
Strongly consistent inventory checking and decrementing.

q: 把订单和库存放在不同数据库，再用锁串起来，一个典型失败模式是什么？
q_en: If orders and inventory live in separate databases and are tied together with locks, what failure mode appears?
options: 订单已创建但库存未扣减时服务崩溃，后续可能超卖
库存数量会自动变成无限
用户位置无法传给 Nearby Service
所有读请求都会强一致
why: 跨数据存储事务需要处理部分成功、补偿和恢复，失败模式比单库事务复杂得多。
why_en: Splitting orders and inventory across stores introduces partial-commit failures that require compensation and recovery.
optionExplanations: 对。订单已创建但库存未扣，崩溃窗口里另一个用户可能买到同一件货。
错。库存数字不会因为崩溃而变多，这是无中生有的说法。
错。这个失败模式和地理查询服务没有因果关系。
错。崩溃通常让状态更不一致，而不是自动变强一致。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - the order exists but stock is not decremented yet, so another order can double-sell.
Wrong - quantity does not increase from a crash; that is a made-up outcome.
Wrong - this failure mode has no causal link to the geography service.
Wrong - a crash typically makes state less consistent, not automatically stronger.
options_en: The order is created but the service crashes before decrementing inventory, so a later order can oversell.
Inventory quantity automatically becomes infinite.
The user's location can no longer reach the Nearby Service.
All reads suddenly become strongly consistent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 订单和库存分别存在不同数据库时，很难保证两边同时成功或同时失败。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross-store transaction cannot easily guarantee that writes to two separate databases both succeed or both fail together.

scenario: 订单放 DynamoDB、库存放 Postgres，两者靠分布式锁串起来，任何一个节点都可能随时崩。
scenario_en: Orders live in DynamoDB and inventory in Postgres, stitched together by a distributed lock, and any node can crash at any moment.

q: 两个订单都要买 A 和 B，但一个先锁 A、另一个先锁 B，可能出现什么问题？
q_en: If two orders both need A and B but lock them in opposite order, what can happen?
options: 库存自动复制
死锁，双方都等对方释放另一个锁
DC 坐标消失
缓存 TTL 变长
why: 多资源分布式锁如果没有统一加锁顺序和超时，很容易在重叠库存上死锁。
why_en: Overlapping multi-item orders can deadlock if distributed locks are acquired in inconsistent orders.
optionExplanations: 错。锁竞争和数据复制毫无关系，这是编造的后果。
对。订单1占着 A 等 B，订单2占着 B 等 A，谁都不能前进。
错。加锁顺序问题不会影响 DC 的位置数据。
错。TTL 是缓存配置，和分布式锁的加锁顺序无关。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - lock contention has nothing to do with data replication; a fabricated effect.
Correct - order 1 holds A and waits for B while order 2 holds B and waits for A.
Wrong - lock ordering issues do not affect a DC's stored coordinates.
Wrong - TTL is a cache setting, unrelated to distributed lock ordering.
options_en: Inventory automatically replicates itself.
Deadlock - each order waits for the other to release its lock.
The DC's coordinates disappear.
The cache TTL grows longer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个及以上执行流互相等待对方持有的资源，永远无法继续。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A deadlock is when two or more processes wait forever for resources held by each other.

scenario: 高峰期并发下单，两个多商品订单都要锁住 A、B 两件库存，锁没有统一顺序也没有超时。
scenario_en: At peak, two concurrent multi-item orders each need to lock stock A and B, with no global lock order and no timeout.

scenario: 面试中希望先给出简单可靠的防超卖方案，库存和订单都可以放进同一个 Postgres。
scenario_en: In the interview, you want a simple reliable oversell-prevention design, and inventory and orders can live in one Postgres database.
q: 最合适的方案是什么？
q_en: What is the best-fit solution?
options: 先写订单记录，几小时后再异步扣减库存
只修改 Redis 里的库存计数，不写关系库
一个 Postgres 事务里检查、下单、扣减
让客户端自己挑 DC 并直接扣减库存
why: 把强一致数据放在同一个 ACID 数据库里，可以让一个事务保证原子性和隔离性。
why_en: Colocating orders and inventory in one ACID database lets a single transaction enforce atomicity and isolation.
whenOtherWins: 如果订单和库存规模极大且强一致边界无法单库承载，才需要更复杂的分片事务或 reservation 流程。
diagram:
flowchart LR
OrderSvc[Order Service] --> Tx[Single DB transaction]
Tx --> Inv[(Inventory rows)]
Tx --> Order[(Order row)]
Tx --> Commit[Commit or rollback]
optionExplanations: 错。几小时的异步窗口足够让库存被超卖多次。
错。Redis 计数不是权威数据源，重启或过期都会丢一致性。
对。同一个 ACID 事务能保证原子性和隔离性，一次成功或一次失败。
错。客户端不可信，选 DC 和扣库存都必须在服务端完成。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - an hours-long async window is plenty of time for repeated overselling.
Wrong - a Redis counter is not the source of truth and loses consistency on restart.
Correct - one ACID transaction guarantees atomicity and isolation: it all commits or rolls back.
Wrong - clients cannot be trusted; picking a DC and decrementing stock must be server-side.
tradeoff: 单库单事务简单可靠 vs 拆库获得各自最优存储引擎
options_en: Write the order record first, then decrement stock asynchronously hours later.
Only change the stock counter in Redis and never touch the relational store.
Do the check, the order insert, and the decrement in one Postgres transaction.
Let the client itself pick a DC and decrement stock directly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库事务的四个保证：原子性、一致性、隔离性、持久性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ACID is the set of transaction guarantees: atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability.

scenario: Orders Service 要在一个事务里检查多个 item 是否有货，成功才创建订单并扣减库存。
scenario_en: Orders Service must check multiple items in one transaction, then create the order and decrement stock only if all checks pass.
q: 哪段事务形态最符合防超卖需求？
q_en: Which transaction shape best prevents overselling?
options: 先给用户返回下单成功，再由后台异步扣减库存
只写入 Redis 缓存计数，不写数据库
SELECT 全部订单后在客户端排序过滤
SERIALIZABLE 事务内锁库存并插订单
why: SERIALIZABLE 或合适的行锁能让并发订单在提交时冲突检测，失败的一方重试或返回缺货。
why_en: A serializable transaction or row locks make conflicting orders serialize so only one can commit against the same stock.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是读 availability，走只读副本和缓存更便宜，不需要锁主库。
optionExplanations: 错。提前应答后台再扣减，窗口期内还是能被超卖。
错。只写缓存等于没有权威库存记录，崩溃就全丢。
错。这是读取和排序订单，不是检查库存或创建订单的手段。
对。这个隔离级别在提交时做冲突检测，两个抢同一件货只有一个能成功。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - answering first and decrementing later still leaves a window for overselling.
Wrong - cache-only writes mean no authoritative record; a crash loses everything.
Wrong - this reads and sorts orders; it does not check stock or create one.
Correct - this isolation level checks conflicts at commit, so only one of two competing orders wins.
tradeoff: 同事务锁定+检查 vs 先应答用户再异步扣减
options_en: Return success to the user first, then decrement stock in a background job.
Write only to the Redis cache counter, never to the database.
SELECT every order and sort and filter it on the client.
Lock stock and insert the order inside a SERIALIZABLE transaction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最严格的数据库隔离级别，保证并发事务的结果和某种串行执行顺序一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SERIALIZABLE is the strictest database isolation level, guaranteeing concurrent transactions behave as if run one at a time.

q: 单个多商品订单里只要一个商品缺货就让整个订单失败，有什么产品层后果？
q_en: If one missing item fails the whole multi-item order, what product consequence follows?
options: 用户需要清楚知道哪些商品导致失败
系统会自动拆成多个支付订单
强一致性失效
Nearby Service 不再需要
why: 全有或全无能避免不完整订单，但必须给用户明确的缺货反馈。
why_en: All-or-nothing ordering prevents partial purchases but requires clear out-of-stock feedback to users.
optionExplanations: 对。全有或全无能防止半成品订单，但用户体验要求明确说明缺货商品。
错。全有或全无策略不会自动拆单，拆单是另一种设计选择。
错。一致性策略没有因为失败反馈而失效。
错。Nearby Service 仍然要判断可服务 DC，与失败反馈无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - all-or-nothing avoids partial orders, but must clearly report which items failed.
Wrong - all-or-nothing does not auto-split orders; splitting is a different design choice.
Wrong - consistency does not break just because a request fails.
Wrong - the Nearby Service is still needed for serviceable-DC checks.
options_en: Users need to clearly know which items caused the failure.
The system automatically splits it into multiple payment orders.
Strong consistency stops working.
The Nearby Service is no longer needed.
scenario: 用户一次买 8 件商品，其中一件刚被附近 DC 的别人买走，订单按全有或全无处理。
scenario_en: A user buys eight items at once, one of them was just taken by someone else at the nearby DC, and the order is all-or-nothing.

q: Availability Service 和 Orders Service 对 Postgres 的读写路径应如何区分？
q_en: How should Availability Service and Orders Service use different Postgres read/write paths?
options: 两者都只读从库，写入统一交给离线批处理任务
Availability 读副本，Orders 写主库
两者都只访问客户端本地缓存，完全不连数据库
Orders 把订单和库存都写进对象存储桶里
why: availability 可容忍轻微旧数据以换取速度；下单扣库存不能旧读或乱写，必须走一致性主路径。
why_en: Availability can tolerate slightly stale replica reads, while orders must use the leader and transactions for strong consistency.
optionExplanations: 错。下单必须同步写 leader，攒到离线批处理挡不住超卖。
对。展示可以容忍轻微旧数据，扣库存必须走一致性主路径。
错。本地缓存不是权威数据源，两条路径都还是要落到数据库。
错。对象存储适合大二进制文件，不适合订单这种结构化事务写入。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - orders must write to the leader synchronously; batching them cannot stop overselling.
Correct - display reads tolerate slight staleness, but stock decrement needs the primary path.
Wrong - a local cache is not authoritative; both paths still need the database.
Wrong - object storage suits large binaries, not structured transactional order writes.
tradeoff: 读副本换低延迟 vs leader 写事务换强一致
options_en: Both read only from replicas, with all writes handed to an offline batch job.
Availability reads a replica; Orders writes to the leader.
Both reach only a client-side local cache and never the database.
Orders writes both the order and the stock into an object-storage bucket.

termDefinitions.meaning: 接受写入的数据库主节点，副本从它同步数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The leader is the database node that accepts writes; replicas sync data from it.

scenario: Gopuff 读约 20k QPS、写约 100 单/秒；展示可以容忍一秒旧数据，扣库存一秒都不行。
scenario_en: Gopuff serves roughly 20k reads per second against about 100 orders per second; display tolerates a second of staleness, decrements do not.

scenario: availability 查询只会访问用户附近的一组 DC，希望每次请求不要扫全量 10k DC x 100k item 库存。
scenario_en: Availability queries touch only nearby DCs, and each request should avoid scanning all 10k DCs times 100k items.
q: 库存表更适合如何分区？
q_en: How should the inventory table be partitioned?
options: 按商品名称的首字母做随机哈希分区排布
把全部库存塞进一张大表且完全不建任何索引
按地区/ZIP 前缀分区，查询只落 1-2 个分区
按用户注册时填写的生日字段做范围分区
why: 本地配送天然有地理局部性；按地区分区把扫描从 10k DC × 100k item 缩到 1-2 个分区内的局部库存。
why_en: Geographic partitioning matches local delivery because availability queries touch only nearby distribution centers.
whenOtherWins: 如果查询总是按 item 全局聚合而不是按位置，item-based 分区可能更合适。
optionExplanations: 错。商品名首字母和用户位置没有关联，查询还是要扫多个分区。
错。无索引单表在 10k DC x 100k item 规模下必然全表扫描。
对。本地配送天然有地理局部性，查询只需命中附近分区。
错。生日和「谁能 1 小时送达」完全无关，纯粹的干扰项。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - an item name's first letter has no relation to user location.
Wrong - one unindexed table at this scale forces full scans.
Correct - local delivery has natural geographic locality, so queries hit only nearby partitions.
Wrong - birthday has no relation to one-hour deliverability; a pure distractor.
tradeoff: 按地理局部性分区 vs 按商品名或用户属性随机分区
options_en: Partition randomly by hashing the first letter of the item name.
Keep all inventory in one big table with absolutely no index.
Partition by region or ZIP prefix so queries hit one or two partitions.
Range-partition by the birthday field the user filled in at signup.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 ZIP 前几位等生成的地理分桶标识，用来做缓存 key 和数据库分区。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A region_id is a geographic bucket, often derived from a ZIP prefix, used for cache keys and database partitioning.

q: 这个写入量级最支持哪条设计判断？
q_en: What design judgment does this write volume support?
options: 写路径需要立刻拆分为分布式写分片集群
读路径完全不需要任何形式的缓存层
这个写入量级说明系统应该放弃强一致性
写路径不需要极端扩展，单库事务够用
why: 日均 100 单/秒远低于单机 Postgres 事务写入能力，真正的扩展压力在读路径（约 20k QPS），不在写路径。
why_en: About one hundred orders per second on average is well within a single Postgres instance's transactional write capacity, so the real scaling pressure is on reads, not writes.
scenario: 系统日订单量约 O(10M)，一天约 10 万秒，平均写入量级约为每秒 100 单（高峰会更高）。
scenario_en: The system handles about O(10M) orders per day; with roughly 100k seconds per day, average write volume is about 100 orders per second, with higher peaks.
options_en: The write path needs to shard into a distributed write cluster right away.
The read path needs no caching layer of any kind.
This write scale means the system should give up strong consistency.
The write path needs no extreme scaling; one database transaction absorbs it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒查询数，衡量读请求的吞吐量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS stands for queries per second, a measure of read request throughput.

optionExplanations: 错。日订单量级不足以逼近分片门槛，现在切分布式写集群是过度设计，还会平添运维复杂度。
错。这一条把写路径和读路径的扩展决策混在一起了——读要不要缓存要看读 QPS，不是写单量。
错。写入压力小恰恰让强一致更容易维持，不是放弃一致性的理由。
对。这个写入体量单机数据库轻松吃得下，高峰翻几倍也用不着现在就上分布式写路径。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - daily order volume is nowhere close to needing a distributed write cluster; sharding now just adds ops overhead for no benefit.
Wrong - this conflates the write path with the read path; whether reads need caching depends on read QPS, not write volume.
Wrong - a light write load makes strong consistency easier to hold, not a reason to abandon it.
Correct - this write volume is easily absorbed by one database instance, even at several times peak, so there's no need for a distributed write path yet.

scenario: 估算 availability QPS 时，假设每个购买用户买前看 10 页，只有 5% 浏览者最终购买。
scenario_en: To estimate availability QPS, assume each buyer views 10 pages before purchasing and only 5% of browsers convert.
q: 哪条估算最贴近文章中的读流量推导？
q_en: Which estimate best matches the availability read-traffic derivation?
why: 订单量反推浏览量能说明 availability 读远多于下单写，是需要缓存和副本的信号。
why_en: Backing into availability traffic from orders shows reads can reach about twenty thousand queries per second.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务转化率和浏览页数不同，估算公式仍可用，但参数要换成实际数据。
optionExplanations: 对。按每天 10 万秒折算订单量，再乘浏览页数、除转化率，约得 2 万 QPS。
错。没除以每天 10 万秒，转化率也乘反了，量级直接飞出去。
错。转化率要做除数：只有 5% 的人下单，浏览量得放大 20 倍。
错。每次购买看 10 页是放大因子，应该乘不是除。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - divide daily orders by seconds/day, multiply by page views, divide by conversion rate.
Wrong - it never divides by seconds per day and multiplies by conversion instead of dividing.
Wrong - conversion belongs in the denominator: only 5% buy, so browsing is 20x larger.
Wrong - the 10 pages per purchase is a multiplier, not a divisor.
tradeoff: 从订单量反推读流量 vs 凭感觉估计一个数字
options_en: 10M / 100k * 10 / 0.05 is about 20,000 requests per second.
10M * 10 * 0.05 is about 5 million requests per second.
10M / 100k * 10 * 0.05 is about 50 requests per second.
10M / 100k / 10 / 0.05 is about 20 requests per second.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最终下单用户占浏览用户的比例，用来把浏览量折算回购买量或反过来估算浏览量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Conversion rate is the share of browsing users who actually purchase, used to translate between browsing volume and order volume.

scenario: availability 查询约 20k QPS，同一地区和附近 DC 组合会被大量重复查询，但结果允许短暂不新。
scenario_en: Availability receives about 20k QPS; the same region and nearby-DC combinations repeat often, and results may be briefly stale.
q: 最直接的读扩展方案是什么？
q_en: What is the most direct way to scale availability reads?
options: 把所有查询都直接打到 Postgres 主库 leader
给 Availability 加 Redis cache，miss 回填
把 availability 的计算推迟到用户下单那一刻才做
把库存数量写进用户浏览器的 cookie 里保存
why: availability 是读多写少且可短暂旧的路径，cache-aside 可以显著降低数据库读压。
why_en: Availability is read-heavy and tolerates brief staleness, so a Redis cache-aside layer cuts database load.
whenOtherWins: 下单扣减库存不能依赖旧缓存，必须重新进入强一致事务。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] --> Cache[(Availability cache)]
Cache -->|miss| Replica[(Read replica)]
Replica --> Avail[Availability Service]
Order[Order commit] --> Invalidate[Invalidate cache]
optionExplanations: 错。20k QPS 全打 leader 会让主库过载，也没利用查询的重复性。
对。同一地区反复被查，缓存能大幅削减数据库读压。
错。用户需要在下单前先看到可用商品，不能等到下单才算。
错。cookie 存在用户设备上，无法被其他用户共享，也不是权威数据源。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - sending all 20k QPS to the leader overloads it and ignores repeated queries.
Correct - the same region is queried repeatedly, so caching sharply cuts database read load.
Wrong - users need to see availability before ordering, not only after.
Wrong - a cookie lives on one device, cannot be shared, and is not authoritative.
tradeoff: 缓存吸收重复读 vs 每次都打库
options_en: Send every query straight to the Postgres leader.
Add a Redis cache in front of Availability, filling on a miss.
Defer computing availability until the moment the user places an order.
Store inventory counts inside the user's browser cookie.

termDefinitions.meaning: 应用先查缓存，未命中时查数据库并把结果写回缓存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cache-aside checks the cache first and, on a miss, reads the database and writes the result back into the cache.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的内存型缓存服务，用来吸收重复读请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis is an in-memory cache commonly used to absorb repeated read traffic.

q: availability cache 设置 1 分钟 TTL 的主要意义和代价是什么？
q_en: What is the main benefit and cost of a one-minute TTL on the availability cache?
options: 保证下单路径的强一致性
让缓存里的库存条目永不过期
降低读压，但可能短暂展示已售罄商品
可以替代订单事务里的库存扣减
why: 短 TTL 让读结果大致新鲜，但缓存仍可能比主库慢一拍，所以只能用于展示 availability。
why_en: A short TTL reduces read load while allowing brief stale availability, so it cannot replace transactional ordering.
optionExplanations: 错。缓存 TTL 和下单一致性是两条不同路径，展示新鲜不等于事务安全。
错。TTL 恰恰是设置过期时间，说「永不过期」正好说反了。
对。短 TTL 减少数据库压力，但缓存这一分钟内可能还没反映最新扣减。
错。缓存只服务展示，真正防超卖仍然靠订单事务。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - cache TTL and order consistency are separate paths.
Wrong - TTL is literally an expiration setting, the opposite of never expiring.
Correct - a short TTL cuts database load but the cache may lag the latest decrement.
Wrong - the cache only serves display; the order transaction does the real oversell prevention.
options_en: It guarantees strong consistency on the ordering path.
It makes cached inventory entries never expire.
It cuts read load but may briefly show a sold-out item as available.
It can replace the stock decrement inside the order transaction.
scenario: availability 读 20k QPS 打爆 Postgres，于是加 Redis 缓存，但库存每秒都在被扣减。
scenario_en: Availability reads at 20k QPS overwhelm Postgres so we add a Redis cache, but stock is being decremented every second.

q: Order Service 扣减库存后，为什么要失效受影响的 availability cache？
q_en: Why invalidate affected availability cache entries after Orders Service decrements inventory?
options: 让订单事务更慢
阻止 Nearby Service 返回 DC
删除所有用户账户
避免继续把已售出的库存展示为可买
why: TTL 兜底不够，扣库存时主动失效相关地区/item cache 能减少过时展示窗口。
why_en: Invalidating affected availability keys after an order reduces the stale window for items that just sold.
diagram:
flowchart LR
Order[Order Service] --> Commit[Inventory decrement]
Commit --> Event[Inventory changed event]
Event --> Cache[Invalidate affected keys]
Cache --> Fresh[Next read reloads]
optionExplanations: 错。失效缓存是订单提交之后的一步，不影响事务本身的耗时。
错。缓存失效和 Nearby Service 判断可服务 DC 是两个不相关的模块。
错。这是无关的破坏性操作，和缓存失效毫无关系。
对。主动失效缩短了「库存已卖出但缓存还显示有货」的窗口。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - cache invalidation happens after commit and does not add to transaction latency.
Wrong - cache invalidation and the Nearby Service's DC lookup are unrelated modules.
Wrong - this is an unrelated destructive action.
Correct - proactive invalidation shortens the window where sold stock still looks available.
options_en: It makes the order transaction slower.
It blocks the Nearby Service from returning DCs.
It deletes all user accounts.
It stops the system from continuing to show sold-out stock as available.
scenario: availability cache 只有 1 分钟 TTL，热门商品在某 DC 售罄后用户仍会看到它可买。
scenario_en: The availability cache has only a one-minute TTL, so after a hot item sells out at a DC users still see it as buyable.

scenario: 即使有 Redis，也会有 cache miss 或冷启动；availability 读可以容忍少量复制延迟。
scenario_en: Even with Redis, cache misses and cold starts happen; availability reads can tolerate a little replica lag.
q: 数据库层应如何扩展 availability 读？
q_en: How should the database layer scale availability reads?
options: 加 Postgres read replicas
所有读都走 leader 并加行锁
给库存表禁用全部数据库索引
把订单直接写到 read replica 上
why: 读副本把查询从 leader 卸载出去，轻微旧库存对展示可接受，但不能用于最终下单扣减。
why_en: Read replicas offload availability queries because a little replica lag is acceptable for display reads.
whenOtherWins: 强一致的下单事务必须访问 leader，不能在只读副本上完成。
optionExplanations: 对。副本承接可容忍轻微延迟的展示读，卸载主库压力。
错。锁 leader 会让读写互相阻塞，完全违背扩展读的目标。
错。禁用索引只会让每次查询更慢，和扩展读没有关系。
错。写只能进 leader，写副本会破坏事务一致性保证。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - replicas absorb display reads that can tolerate slight lag, offloading the leader.
Wrong - locking the leader for reads blocks writes too, defeating the point of scaling reads.
Wrong - disabling indexes only makes every query slower.
Wrong - writes must go to the leader; writing to a replica breaks transactional guarantees.
tradeoff: 读副本卸载 leader vs 所有读都锁主库
options_en: Add Postgres read replicas.
Send every read to the leader and take a row lock.
Disable all database indexes on the inventory table.
Write orders directly to a read replica.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从主库异步同步数据、只处理读请求的数据库节点，可能有轻微延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read replica is a database node that asynchronously copies data from the leader and serves only reads, with possible slight lag.

q: 补全库存分区策略：
q_en: Complete the inventory partitioning strategy.
text: 由于用户只会查附近 DC，可以用 ZIP 前 {{3}} 位或类似 region_id 给库存分区，让查询通常只打到 {{1-2}} 个分区。
why: 地理分区利用本地配送的访问局部性，减少每次 availability 查询扫描的数据量。
why_en: Region-based partitioning uses delivery locality so availability queries usually touch only one or two partitions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据 ZIP 前几位等生成的地理分区标识。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A region_id is a geographic partition key typically derived from a ZIP-code prefix.

q: 补全 Gopuff 的规模锚点：
q_en: Complete the scale anchors for the Gopuff design.
text: 系统要支持约 {{10k}} 个 Distribution Centers、{{100k}} 个 catalog items，并处理 {{O(10M)}} orders/day。
why: 这些数量级决定了 availability 读需要缓存、分区和副本，但订单写平均量仍可由事务型数据库承接。
why_en: The scale anchors justify caching and partitioning for reads while keeping transactional ordering feasible.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数量级记号，表示大约一千万这个量级，不是精确值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(10M) is order-of-magnitude notation meaning roughly ten million, not an exact count.

q: 补全可送达库存定义：
q_en: Complete the definition of deliverable availability.
text: 对某个位置的有效 availability 是 {{1 小时内可送达}} 的所有附近 DC 库存的 {{union / sum}}。
why: 题目不是查单个仓，而是查当前位置所有可服务仓的合并可用量。
why_en: Effective availability is the union or sum of stock from all distribution centers that can deliver within one hour.

q: Nearby Service 为什么可以每几分钟从 DC 表同步一次到内存？
q_en: Why can Nearby Service sync DC records into memory every few minutes?
options: DC 每秒都会移动
DC 是建筑物，位置变化很慢
库存数量只能存在内存
订单必须在客户端执行
why: 配送中心位置是低频变化数据，周期性同步到内存能减少每次附近查询的数据库访问。
why_en: Distribution centers rarely move, so periodically syncing their locations into memory avoids database reads on every nearby query.
optionExplanations: 错。这个说法和物理常识相反，DC 是固定建筑，不会移动。
对。位置几乎不变，几分钟同步一次内存完全足够新鲜。
错。这里混淆了 DC 位置同步和库存数量存储两件事。
错。订单执行位置和 DC 数据同步频率是两个不相关的话题。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - this contradicts physical reality; a DC is a fixed building.
Correct - location barely changes, so syncing to memory every few minutes stays fresh enough.
Wrong - this conflates syncing DC locations with where inventory counts are stored.
Wrong - where orders execute is unrelated to how often DC data syncs.
options_en: Distribution centers move every second.
A DC is a building, so its location changes very slowly.
Inventory counts can only live in memory.
Orders must execute on the client.
scenario: Nearby Service 每秒要为约 20k 次 availability 查询筛附近 DC，而 DC 表只有 1 万行。
scenario_en: The Nearby Service filters nearby DCs for about 20k availability queries per second, against a DC table of only 10,000 rows.

q: 对所有 10k DC 都调用外部 travel time 服务，会带来什么问题？
q_en: What problem comes from calling an external travel-time service for all 10k DCs?
options: 查询结果里的可用库存会自动变得更准确
订单事务会自动获得 ACID 隔离属性
外部调用数和延迟过高，多数 DC 送不到
读副本集群会自动按流量扩容
why: 昂贵外部调用必须先用便宜的地理粗筛缩小候选集，否则延迟和成本都不可接受。
why_en: Calling travel time for every distribution center is too slow and expensive because most candidates are obviously too far away.
optionExplanations: 错。查更多 DC 不会让库存数字更准，准确性来自库存数据本身。
错。事务的 ACID 属性由数据库设计决定，与调用多少个外部服务无关。
对。对全部 1 万个 DC 调用外部服务，多数明显太远，纯粹浪费延迟和成本。
错。副本扩容需要单独配置，不会因为多调用一个外部服务而自动发生。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - querying more DCs doesn't make stock numbers more accurate.
Wrong - a transaction's ACID property comes from the database design.
Correct - calling all 10,000 DCs wastes latency and cost on candidates that could never deliver.
Wrong - replica scaling requires separate provisioning, not an automatic side effect.
options_en: The available inventory in results automatically becomes more accurate.
The order transaction automatically gains ACID isolation.
Too many external calls and too much latency, and most DCs could never deliver.
The read-replica cluster automatically scales with traffic.
scenario: availability 查询的延迟预算是 100ms，行车时间来自按调用计费、有配额的外部 API。
scenario_en: An availability query has a 100 millisecond latency budget, and travel time comes from a metered external API with a quota.

q: 为什么 availability 可以短暂不一致，而 ordering 不行？
q_en: Why can availability be briefly inconsistent while ordering cannot?
options: availability 请求其实完全不访问库存数据
ordering 请求其实完全不需要数据库
两者对一致性的要求其实完全相同
availability 是展示，ordering 是扣减和承诺
why: 展示错了可以在下单时返回缺货；订单成功后却不能再发现商品已被别人买走。
why_en: Availability is advisory and can be corrected at checkout, while a successful order is a commitment against physical stock.
optionExplanations: 错。availability 恰恰要读库存（或缓存的库存）才能展示数量。
错。下单必须写数据库事务，这是防超卖的核心手段。
错。这正是本题的关键区别，两者一致性要求截然不同。
对。展示错了可以在下单时纠正；订单成功却发现商品已被买走则无法接受。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - availability precisely reads inventory (or its cache) to show a quantity.
Wrong - ordering must write inside a database transaction.
Wrong - this is exactly the key distinction the card is testing.
Correct - a wrong display can be corrected at checkout, but a committed order cannot.
tradeoff: 展示可短暂不新鲜 vs 下单必须强一致
options_en: Availability requests never actually touch inventory data.
Ordering requests never actually need a database.
Both paths actually have exactly the same consistency requirement.
Availability is advisory display; ordering is a physical commitment against stock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 写入后短时间内不同副本可能看到不同结果，但最终会收敛一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eventual consistency means different replicas may briefly disagree after a write but converge over time.

scenario: Gopuff 页面先展示可用量，用户点下单时后端才真正扣减某个 DC 的实物库存。
scenario_en: A Gopuff page shows availability first, and only at checkout does the backend actually decrement physical stock at a DC.

q: Gopuff 系统的基础最终方案包含哪些组件？（多选）
q_en: Which components are in the basic final Gopuff design? (Select all)
options: Availability Service
Orders Service
Nearby Service
单一 Postgres 作为库存和订单的强一致存储
why: 三类服务分别处理读、写和可送达判断，Postgres leader 支撑订单事务，副本和分区支撑读。
why_en: The design uses availability, order, and nearby services around a shared transactional Postgres store.
optionExplanations: 对。它负责按位置聚合库存并服务读请求。
对。它负责在单事务里检查、创建订单并扣减库存。
对。它是两条路径共用的可服务 DC 判断逻辑。
对。同库让订单和库存能用一个 ACID 事务保证一致。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - it aggregates inventory by location and serves reads.
Correct - it checks stock, creates the order, and decrements stock in one transaction.
Correct - it is the shared serviceable-DC logic both paths depend on.
Correct - one database lets orders and inventory share a single ACID transaction.
options_en: Availability Service.
Orders Service.
Nearby Service.
A single Postgres database as the strongly consistent store for inventory and orders.
scenario: 要同时满足 100ms 的 availability 读、强一致下单和 1 小时可送达判断，给出首版整体方案。
scenario_en: The first-pass design must serve 100ms availability reads, strongly consistent ordering, and one-hour deliverability checks at once.

q: 把强一致下单事务的步骤排好序：
q_en: Put the strongly consistent order transaction steps in the right order.
steps: 如果任一商品不足，事务失败并返回缺货
检查附近 DC 中请求商品库存是否足够
创建 Order 和 OrderItems 记录
扣减或标记相应 Inventory 为 ordered
提交事务并返回订单
why: 核心约束是检查和扣减必须在同一事务内；实际实现中失败判断可在插入前或约束冲突后处理。
why_en: The essential point is that stock checks, order creation, and inventory updates happen inside one transaction.
diagram:
flowchart TD
Start[Begin transaction] --> Lock[Lock inventory rows]
Lock --> Check[Check all quantities]
Check --> Deduct[Deduct stock]
Deduct --> Create[Create order]
Create --> Commit[Commit]
tradeoff: 检查+扣减在同一事务 vs 分成多次调用

q: Gopuff 设计明确放在线下范围（out of scope）的内容有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which items are explicitly out of scope for the Gopuff design? (Select all)
options: 支付处理
司机路径规划和配送
搜索和 catalog API
取消和退货
why: 题目边界刻意收窄到 availability 和下单一致性，避免在支付、配送、搜索上耗时。
why_en: The problem intentionally excludes payments, routing, search, catalog APIs, cancellations, and returns.
optionExplanations: 对。支付被明确排除，专注于库存和下单一致性。
对。配送调度是另一个独立问题，本题不覆盖。
对。搜索和 catalog API 被划出范围，只留 availability 查询。
对。取消和退货流程留到线下，不在首版设计内。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - payments are excluded to focus on inventory and order consistency.
Correct - driver routing/dispatch is a separate problem not covered here.
Correct - search and catalog APIs are scoped out, leaving only availability queries.
Correct - cancellations and returns are left out of the first-version design.
options_en: Payment processing.
Driver routing and delivery.
Search and catalog APIs.
Cancellations and returns.
scenario: 面试只有 45 分钟，必须把范围收在 availability 聚合和下单防超卖上，其余明确划走。
scenario_en: With only 45 minutes, scope must stay on availability aggregation and oversell prevention, and everything else gets explicitly cut.

q: 补全 Item / Inventory 类比：
q_en: Complete the Item versus Inventory analogy.
text: 可以把 {{Item}} 类比成面向用户的 Class，把 {{Inventory}} 类比成某个 DC 中具体可扣减的 Instance。
why: 这个类比帮助区分目录语义和物理库存语义，是本题建模的关键。
why_en: The class-versus-instance analogy separates catalog items from physical inventory at a distribution center.

scenario: availability 请求总是按用户位置找附近 DC，希望 cache key 和数据库分区都能体现地理局部性。
scenario_en: Availability requests always find nearby DCs from user location, so cache keys and database partitions should preserve geographic locality.
q: 哪种 region_id 生成思路最贴合文章？
q_en: Which region_id generation approach best fits this design?
options: 用 ZIP 前 3 位做 region bucket
按用户姓名拼音首字母分成 26 组
按订单创建时间戳的毫秒数取模分桶
完全用随机数生成 region_id，不看任何字段
why: 附近 DC 和用户位置有地理局部性；ZIP 前 3 位把 10k DC 切成 ≈900 个 region bucket，缓存 key 和分区都按它命中。
why_en: A regional bucket such as a ZIP prefix aligns cache keys and partitions with local delivery geography.
whenOtherWins: 如果城市边界和 ZIP 不匹配严重，可以用 geohash、H3 或实际服务区多边形代替。
optionExplanations: 对。region bucket 让相近位置的请求命中同一批缓存 key 和分区。
错。姓名首字母和用户地理位置没有任何关系。
错。时间戳会让同一地区的请求分散到完全不同的分区，破坏局部性。
错。完全随机等于放弃了地理局部性，查询还是要扫全量。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - a region bucket makes nearby requests hit the same cache keys and partitions.
Wrong - a name's first letter has no relation to a user's geography.
Wrong - a timestamp scatters same-region requests across unrelated partitions.
Wrong - full randomness abandons geographic locality, forcing full scans again.
tradeoff: 地理分桶 region_id vs 随机/无关属性分区
options_en: Use the first three ZIP digits as a region bucket.
Group into 26 buckets by the first letter of the romanized user name.
Bucket by the millisecond value of the order-creation timestamp, modulo N.
Generate region_id from a random number, ignoring every field.

q: 选择单个 Postgres 承载订单和库存的主要代价是什么？
q_en: What is the main cost of using one Postgres database for orders and inventory?
options: 完全不能保证 ACID
库存和订单的扩展边界被耦合，不能各自选存储
读副本从此不能存在
Nearby Service 从此无法复用
why: 单库事务简化一致性，但也让不同工作负载共享同一扩展和存储边界。
why_en: A single transactional database simplifies consistency but couples the scaling boundaries of orders and inventory.
optionExplanations: 错。单库恰恰是为了拿到 ACID，说反了。
对。库存和订单共用同一套存储，扩容、选型都被绑在一起。
错。单库照样可以配读副本，两者不冲突。
错。Nearby Service 是独立服务，复用与订单/库存存储选型无关。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - a single database is precisely how ACID is achieved; this is backwards.
Correct - inventory and orders share one store, so scaling and storage choices are locked together.
Wrong - a single primary database can still have read replicas.
Wrong - the Nearby Service is independent of the orders/inventory storage choice.
options_en: It cannot guarantee ACID at all.
Inventory and orders share the same scaling boundary and cannot pick separate stores.
Read replicas can no longer exist.
The Nearby Service can no longer be reused.
scenario: 库存和订单同放一个 Postgres：写约 100 单/秒轻松，但读约 20k QPS 且两类数据增长速度不同。
scenario_en: Inventory and orders share one Postgres: about 100 writes per second is easy, but reads run near 20k QPS and the two data sets grow at different rates.

q: 补全为什么要把强一致数据共置：
q_en: Complete why strongly consistent data should be colocated.
text: 当检查库存、创建订单、扣减库存必须一起成功或失败时，把数据放在同一个 {{ACID}} 数据库里，可用一个 {{transaction}} 管住原子性和隔离性。
why: 这是本题从分布式锁转向单库事务的核心理由。
why_en: Colocating strongly consistent data in one ACID database lets one transaction enforce atomicity and isolation.

q: availability 查询常见需要哪些索引或访问维度？（多选）
q_en: Which indexes or access dimensions does availability commonly need? (Select all)
options: Inventory(dc_id, item_id) 或 region/item 相关索引
Item(id) 用于 join 商品元数据
DistributionCenter(region_id/lat/lng) 用于附近筛选
Order(created_at) 作为库存查询主索引
why: 读路径围绕附近 DC、item 和商品元数据展开，索引按 dc_id × item_id 组合；订单时间不是 availability 的过滤维度。
why_en: Availability reads need indexes around distribution centers, item IDs, and catalog joins, not primarily order timestamps.
optionExplanations: 对。availability 查询按 DC 和 item 过滤，这个组合索引是核心。
对。join 拿商品名称和描述离不开按 id 查 Item。
对。筛选可服务 DC 要靠位置或 region 索引。
错。这是按下单时间排序的维度，和按位置找库存的查询模式对不上。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - availability queries filter by DC and item, making this composite index central.
Correct - joining for item name and description needs an id lookup on Item.
Correct - filtering serviceable DCs relies on a location or region index.
Wrong - this dimension sorts by order time, which does not match a location-based stock lookup.
options_en: Inventory(dc_id, item_id) or a similar region/item index.
Item(id) for joining catalog metadata.
DistributionCenter(region_id/lat/lng) for nearby filtering.
Order(created_at) as the primary index for inventory queries.
scenario: availability 查询要在 100ms 内按用户附近 DC 聚合 item 库存，并 join 商品元数据。
scenario_en: An availability query must aggregate item stock across the user nearby DCs and join catalog metadata within 100 milliseconds.

q: 为什么定义 API 时要把 location 传给 availability 和 order 两条路径？
q_en: Why should both availability and order APIs receive the user's location?
options: location 只用于支付风控和欺诈识别
location 可以直接替代库存表的查询
下单时后端要重新确认可 1 小时送达
location 能让下单避免使用数据库事务
why: availability 展示和 order 提交都依赖同一个可服务 DC 集合，后端下单时必须重新校验。
why_en: Both availability and order placement depend on the set of distribution centers that can deliver to the user within one hour.
optionExplanations: 错。这题里 location 用于地理可送达判断，不是支付风控字段。
错。location 决定用哪些 DC，不能替代真实的库存数据。
对。展示时算过一次，下单时后端必须用同一逻辑重新核实。
错。location 和是否用事务是两件事，强一致检查照样需要事务。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - location drives deliverability checks, not payment fraud fields.
Wrong - location decides which DCs to use; it cannot substitute for real inventory data.
Correct - availability computes it once for display, and the backend must recheck at order time.
Wrong - location and transaction use are separate concerns.
options_en: Location is only used for payment risk and fraud detection.
Location can directly replace querying the inventory table.
At order time the backend must reconfirm one-hour deliverability.
Location lets ordering avoid using a database transaction.
scenario: 用户看到的可用量来自附近 DC，但从看到到点下单之间，位置和库存都可能已经变了。
scenario_en: The availability a user sees comes from nearby DCs, but between viewing and checkout both location and stock may have changed.

scenario: 订单事务需要保证没有两个用户买到同一件库存，而 availability 查询只用于展示。
scenario_en: Order transactions must prevent two users from buying the same stock, while availability queries are only advisory display.
q: 哪些请求必须打 Postgres leader？
q_en: Which requests must hit the Postgres leader?
options: 所有 availability cache hit
只读商品详情请求
附近 DC 内存查询
创建订单和扣减库存请求
why: 只有 leader 能在事务内执行一致写入和冲突检测；读副本适合可容忍旧数据的查询。
why_en: Order creation and inventory decrement must hit the leader because they require transactional writes and conflict detection.
whenOtherWins: 纯展示类 availability 请求可以先走 Redis 或 read replica，避免压 leader。
optionExplanations: 错。缓存命中根本不碰数据库，更谈不上打 leader。
错。纯展示的商品详情可以走副本或缓存，不需要强一致。
错。附近 DC 数据是内存里的周期性同步副本，不是 leader 查询。
对。写入和冲突检测必须发生在 leader 的事务里，才能保证唯一成功。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - a cache hit never touches the database, let alone the leader.
Wrong - purely display product details can use a replica or cache.
Wrong - nearby DC data is a periodically synced in-memory copy, not a leader query.
Correct - writes and conflict detection must happen inside a leader transaction.
tradeoff: 写请求必须走 leader vs 展示读可以走副本/缓存
options_en: Every availability cache hit.
Read-only product detail requests.
In-memory nearby-DC lookups.
Order creation and inventory decrement requests.

q: 把 availability 读扩展的优化顺序排好：
q_en: Put the availability read-scaling optimizations in the right order.
steps: 按地理 region 对库存分区，限制查询范围
先用 Nearby Service 缩小到可服务 DC
用 Redis cache 承接重复 availability 查询
cache miss 和低一致性读走 read replicas
why: 先降低每次查询涉及的数据，再用缓存和读副本降低数据库压力。
why_en: Availability scaling first narrows the data by geography, then uses cache and replicas to absorb read traffic.

q: 把 Gopuff 最终设计的主链路排好序：
q_en: Put the main flow of the final Gopuff design in the right order.
steps: Orders Service 对 leader 执行单事务，检查并扣减库存
Availability Service 用 Nearby Service 找可服务 DC
附近库存按 region 分区并通过 read replicas/Redis 加速
Nearby Service 用半径粗筛加 travel time 服务判断 1 小时送达
Order 成功后失效受影响 availability cache
why: 最终方案把地理可送达、快速读、强一致写和缓存失效串在一起。
why_en: The final design combines serviceability, fast regional reads, transactional ordering, and cache invalidation.

scenario: 面试时间有限，需求集中在 availability 和 ordering，不要求支付、搜索或复杂微服务拆分。
scenario_en: Interview time is limited, and the requirements focus on availability and ordering, not payments, search, or complex microservice decomposition.
q: 整体设计应该优先追求什么？
q_en: What should the overall design prioritize?
options: 先用简单服务边界和单库事务满足需求，再优化读热点
一开始就设计几十个微服务和跨库协调器
整个设计只做搜索系统
完全不讨论任何一致性问题
why: 本题的关键判断是哪里需要强一致、哪里可以用缓存和副本，不需要过度扩展到线下功能。
why_en: The strongest answer keeps the core design simple, uses transactions where consistency matters, and optimizes the read-heavy path.
whenOtherWins: 如果面试官明确扩展到支付、配送调度或 catalog 搜索，再引入相应专门系统。
optionExplanations: 对。先用简单架构满足核心需求，再针对已验证的读热点做优化。
错。题目范围有限，一开始就上几十个微服务是过度设计。
错。搜索功能在本题里被明确划为线下范围，不该是设计重点。
错。防超卖是本题最核心的非功能需求，不讨论一致性等于漏掉重点。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - meet the core need with a simple architecture, then optimize the confirmed hotspot.
Wrong - the scope is limited; dozens of microservices from day one is over-engineering.
Wrong - search is explicitly out of scope here.
Wrong - oversell prevention is the core non-functional requirement.
tradeoff: 先简单满足需求 vs 一开始就上重架构
options_en: Start with simple service boundaries and a single-database transaction, then optimize the read hotspot.
Design dozens of microservices and a cross-database coordinator from day one.
Make the whole design only about search.
Never discuss consistency at all.

scenario: 订单写 DynamoDB、库存写 Postgres，靠分布式锁串起来。服务在创建订单后、扣减库存前崩溃，锁按 TTL 自动释放。
scenario_en: Orders live in DynamoDB and inventory in Postgres, tied together by a distributed lock. The service crashes after creating the order but before decrementing inventory, and the lock expires on its TTL.
q: 这套跨库加锁方案要靠什么机制收拾残局？
q_en: What mechanism has to clean up after this cross-database locking approach?
options: 后台 sweeper 定期扫出半成品订单并反转
重启后 Postgres 的 SERIALIZABLE 事务会自动回滚这次跨库写入
把锁的 TTL 调到一小时，崩溃期间就没人能抢走这批库存
等 Redis 里的 availability 缓存过期，下次查询自然读回正确库存
options_en: A background sweeper periodically finds half-finished orders and reverses them.
After restart, a SERIALIZABLE transaction in Postgres rolls the cross-database write back on its own.
Raise the lock TTL to an hour so nobody can grab that inventory while the service is down.
Let the Redis availability cache expire so the next query naturally reads the right stock again.
optionExplanations: 对。中间态没有任何事务会撤销它，只能异步识别并反转；代价是扫描周期内仍会超卖。
错。SERIALIZABLE 只覆盖一个 Postgres 事务的边界，订单那一半写在别的库里，回滚够不到。
错。锁只挡并发抢占，挡不住崩溃留下的订单与库存不一致，还会让正常请求空等一小时。
错。缓存回填读到的是数据库里那份已经错的库存数量，脏数据的源头没被修。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - nothing rolls the intermediate state back, so it must be found and reversed asynchronously; you oversell until it runs.
Wrong - SERIALIZABLE only covers one Postgres transaction; the order half lives in another store the rollback cannot reach.
Wrong - a lock stops concurrent grabs, not the inconsistency a crash leaves behind, and it stalls normal requests for an hour.
Wrong - the refill reads the already-wrong quantity from the database; the bad source data is untouched.
why: 跨库部分成功的中间态没有任何事务会替你撤销，只能靠 sweeper 异步补偿；代价是从崩溃到扫描完成这段窗口里，同一批库存会被再卖一次。
why_en: Nothing rolls back a half-finished cross-database write, so a background sweeper has to reverse it, and you oversell during the window before it runs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 定期扫描半成品记录并把它们反转或补齐的后台任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sweeper is a background job that periodically scans for half-finished records and reverses or completes them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 跨进程共享的互斥标记，让同一份资源同一时刻只被一个请求持有。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distributed lock is a shared mutual-exclusion marker so only one request holds a given resource at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 存活时间，到期后锁或缓存条目自动失效。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL stands for Time To Live, after which a lock or cache entry expires automatically.

termDefinitions.meaning: Postgres 最强隔离级别，让并发事务的结果等价于某种串行执行顺序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SERIALIZABLE is the strictest isolation level, making concurrent transactions behave as if they ran one after another.

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 的托管键值/文档数据库，单表操作快但不跨表跨库事务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DynamoDB is a managed key-value store from AWS that is fast per item but does not span other databases in one transaction.

scenario: Inventory 建模成实物实例：某个 DC 里的每一件 Cheetos 是一行。下单事务必须保证两个用户拿不到同一件实物。
scenario_en: Inventory is modeled as physical instances: each single bag of Cheetos in a DC is its own row. The order transaction must ensure two users never get the same physical unit.
q: 下单事务应该怎样标记被买走的库存？
q_en: How should the order transaction mark the inventory it just sold?
options: 把该 DC 该商品的 count 字段减一
把选中的 Inventory 行状态更新为 ordered
只在 Orders 表插一行，库存留到夜间批处理再对账
在 Redis 里对该商品的计数器执行 DECR，数据库不动
options_en: Decrement a count column for that item at that DC.
Update the chosen Inventory rows to status ordered.
Only insert a row in Orders and reconcile inventory in a nightly batch.
Run DECR on a Redis counter for that item and leave the database alone.
optionExplanations: 错。计数只说明还剩几件，指不出是哪一件归了谁，拣货和退货都没法对账。
对。Inventory 是实物实例，行状态机让每一件在同一时刻只能属于一个订单。
错。库存和订单之间留出一整夜空窗，期间同一件实物会被反复卖出去。
错。Redis 不在那笔 SERIALIZABLE 事务里，计数器和库存表可能各错一半。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong - a count says how many are left but not which unit belongs to whom, so picking and returns cannot reconcile.
Correct - Inventory is a physical instance, and a per-row state machine lets only one order own each unit at a time.
Wrong - it leaves a whole night between inventory and orders, during which the same unit gets sold repeatedly.
Wrong - Redis is outside that SERIALIZABLE transaction, so the counter and the table can drift apart.
why: 实体建模把 Inventory 定义成实物实例而不是数量，所以扣减也要落到行状态；代价是行数随实物件数线性增长，比一个计数字段贵得多。
why_en: Because Inventory models a physical unit rather than a quantity, the sale has to land on that row's state, at the cost of one row per physical unit instead of one counter.
tradeoff: 实例级行状态机 vs 单个数量计数字段
whenOtherWins: 如果商品完全可互换、也不需要追踪具体哪一件被拣走，一个 quantity 计数字段更省空间、更新也更便宜。

termDefinitions.meaning: Postgres 最强隔离级别，让并发事务的结果等价于某种串行执行顺序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SERIALIZABLE is the strictest isolation level, making concurrent transactions behave as if they ran one after another.

termDefinitions.meaning: 微型配送中心，实物库存实际存放的地点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A DC is a Distribution Center, the physical site where inventory actually sits.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 的原子自减命令，把一个整数键减一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DECR is the Redis command that atomically decrements an integer key by one.

scenario: availability 的约 20k QPS 全部打在 Postgres 读副本上，晚高峰是白天的三倍，但副本规格和数量一年没动过。
scenario_en: All roughly 20k QPS of availability traffic hits Postgres read replicas; the evening peak is three times daytime, but replica size and count have not changed in a year.
q: 副本不随流量调整规格会先出现什么？
q_en: What breaks first when replica sizing is not tuned to traffic?
options: 副本 CPU 打满、复制延迟拉大，库存显示变旧
leader 会自动把多余的写事务分流到只读副本上执行
Postgres 会拒绝新的写事务，直到所有副本都追上 leader
分区键被自动重算，热点地区的数据迁移到新副本上
options_en: Replica CPU saturates, replication lag grows, and stock shown to users goes stale.
The leader automatically offloads surplus write transactions onto the read-only replicas.
Postgres refuses new write transactions until every replica has caught up with the leader.
The partition key is recomputed automatically and hot regions migrate onto new replicas.
optionExplanations: 对。查询排队后副本回放 WAL 变慢，用户看到的是几秒前的库存。
错。写只能在 leader 上提交，副本是只读的，加副本分摊不了写。
错。异步复制不会因为副本落后就阻塞 leader 提交，只会让延迟越拉越大。
错。分区键是设计时定死的，没有哪个组件会自动搬迁热点数据。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - once queries queue up, the replica replays WAL more slowly and users see stock from seconds ago.
Wrong - writes commit only on the leader; replicas are read-only, so more of them cannot absorb writes.
Wrong - asynchronous replication does not block leader commits just because a replica trails.
Wrong - the partition key is fixed at design time; nothing relocates hot data by itself.
why: 读副本只在容量足够时才兜得住 20k QPS，副本数量和规格是要跟着流量持续调的运维旋钮；扩容的代价是每加一台都要复制全量写入。
why_en: Read replicas only absorb 20k QPS while they have headroom, so their size and count are an ongoing operational knob, and every extra replica replays the full write stream.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从 leader 异步复制数据、只处理读请求的数据库副本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read replica asynchronously copies data from the leader and serves read-only queries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 副本落后于 leader 的时间差，期间副本上的数据是旧的。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Replication lag is how far a replica trails the leader, during which its data is stale.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒查询数，衡量读流量的单位。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS stands for Queries Per Second, the unit used to measure read traffic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 中央处理器，副本打满 CPU 后查询开始排队变慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit; once a replica saturates its CPU, queries start queueing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预写日志，Postgres 先写它再改数据页，副本靠回放它跟上 leader。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WAL stands for Write-Ahead Log; Postgres writes it before changing pages, and replicas replay it to catch up.

scenario: 库存按 ZIP 前三位聚成 region_id 分区。曼哈顿那个 region 的查询和订单量是多数 region 的几十倍。
scenario_en: Inventory is partitioned by a region id built from the first three ZIP digits. The Manhattan region sees dozens of times the queries and orders of a typical region.
q: 按地理分区在这种人口分布下的风险是什么？
q_en: What is the risk of geographic partitioning under this population distribution?
options: 单个分区和它的副本先被打满，成为整库瓶颈
跨 region 的查询会被迫做全表扫描再合并结果
SERIALIZABLE 事务在分区表上不再保证原子性
同一个 region_id 的商品会被拆散到不同副本上
options_en: One partition and its replicas saturate first and become the bottleneck for the whole database.
Cross-region queries are forced into a full table scan and a merge of the results.
SERIALIZABLE transactions stop being atomic once the table is partitioned.
Items sharing a region id get scattered across different replicas.
optionExplanations: 对。分区把负载按地理切开，但地理本身不均匀，最密的那片先到顶。
错。本题的查询天然只覆盖用户附近 1-2 个 region，没有跨全表的访问模式。
错。分区不改变事务隔离语义，同一分区内的行锁和冲突检测照常工作。
错。分区键的作用恰恰相反：同一 region 的数据被聚在一起。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - partitioning splits load geographically, but geography itself is uneven, so the densest slice tops out first.
Wrong - queries here only cover the one or two regions near the user; there is no full-table access pattern.
Wrong - partitioning does not change isolation semantics; row locks and conflict detection still work.
Wrong - the partition key does the opposite: it keeps one region's data together.
why: 地理分区靠局部性把扫描缩到 1-2 个分区，但人口密度不均意味着热 region 会先打满自己的分区和副本；代价是要持续监控并把过热 region 再切细。
why_en: Geographic partitioning keeps a query inside one or two shards, but uneven density means the hottest region saturates first, so you must keep watching and split it further.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按分区键把一张大表水平切成多个物理片段，查询只落其中几片。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Partitioning splits one large table horizontally by a partition key so a query only touches a few shards.

termDefinitions.meaning: 美国邮编的前三位，本题用它把邻近 DC 聚成一个 region_id。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The ZIP prefix is the first three digits of a US postal code, used here to group nearby DCs into one region id.

termDefinitions.meaning: Postgres 最强隔离级别，让并发事务的结果等价于某种串行执行顺序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SERIALIZABLE is the strictest isolation level, making concurrent transactions behave as if they ran one after another.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从 leader 异步复制数据、只处理读请求的数据库副本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read replica asynchronously copies data from the leader and serves read-only queries.

scenario: GoPuff 面试进行到读路径，你刚指出 availability 每次都直查数据库可能扛不住，但还没选任何方案。
scenario_en: In the GoPuff interview you have just flagged that hitting the database on every availability query may not hold up, but you have not picked a solution yet.
q: 此时插入一段 QPS 估算的价值是什么？
q_en: What is the value of pausing here to estimate QPS?
options: 给双方一个共同的数量级，用来权衡下一步方案
先把每个实体的存储字节数逐个算清楚再开始画框图
算出十年后的总存储量，用来决定要采购多少块磁盘
在需求澄清阶段就把每个接口的延迟预算算到毫秒
options_en: It gives both sides a shared order of magnitude for weighing the next choice.
It nails down the byte size of every entity before you start drawing any boxes.
It projects ten-year total storage so you can decide how many disks to buy.
It budgets every endpoint's latency down to milliseconds during requirements.
optionExplanations: 对。20k QPS 这个数直接决定要不要加 cache 和读副本，是下一步的输入。
错。字节数不影响读路径的扩展选择，在这个岔口算它换不来任何判断。
错。本题的瓶颈是读吞吐不是容量，磁盘采购不是面试里要解的问题。
错。延迟预算这里是给定的 NFR（<100ms），不需要也不该在开场推算。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - the 20k QPS figure directly decides whether you add a cache and replicas; it feeds the next step.
Wrong - byte sizing does not change how you scale the read path, so it buys no judgement at this fork.
Wrong - the bottleneck here is read throughput, not capacity; disk procurement is not the question.
Wrong - the latency budget here is a given NFR of under 100ms, not something to derive up front.
why: 估算的用途是把一个具体数字塞进正在做的决策：20k QPS 才让 cache 与读副本变成必需项。在没有瓶颈的地方算数字只烧时间，不改变任何选择。
why_en: An estimate is worth doing when its number feeds the decision you are making right now, like 20k QPS forcing caching and replicas; elsewhere it just burns interview time.
tradeoff: 在已识别的瓶颈处按需估算 vs 开场把所有数字算一遍
whenOtherWins: 如果题目本身就是容量题（比如设计冷数据归档），前期把总字节数算出来才是主线，值得先做。

scenario: GoPuff 要枚举核心实体。先想到的名词是 Order 和 Item，但系统还必须知道每一件实物具体在哪个 DC。
scenario_en: You are enumerating GoPuff's core entities. Order and Item come to mind first, but the system also has to know which DC each physical unit sits in.
q: 枚举核心实体应该从哪一头开始？
q_en: Which end should you start from when enumerating core entities?
options: 从最具体的物理实体出发，再推到抽象实体
从最抽象的聚合实体出发，再往下拆出物理实体
照搬 REST 资源路径，有几个 endpoint 就写几个实体
等 deep dive 里确定了分区键之后再回头定实体
options_en: Start from the most concrete physical entities and work up to abstract ones.
Start from the most abstract aggregate entities and decompose down to physical ones.
Mirror the REST resource paths and write one entity per endpoint.
Wait until the deep dive fixes the partition key, then come back and define entities.
optionExplanations: 对。先钉住 Inventory 这类实物实例，Order、Cart 自然是它们的集合。
错。从 Order 往下推容易停在 Item 这一层，漏掉'实物在哪个 DC'这个实体。
错。因果反了：REST 资源是从实体推出来的，先有实体才有 endpoint。
错。分区键要靠实体的访问模式才能选，顺序颠倒会两头都定不下来。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - pin down physical instances like Inventory first, and Order or Cart fall out as collections of them.
Wrong - working down from Order tends to stop at Item and miss the entity that says which DC holds the unit.
Wrong - the causality is backwards: REST resources are derived from entities, not the other way round.
Wrong - the partition key is chosen from the entities' access patterns, so this order settles neither.
why: 从实物出发能保证 Inventory 这种'物理实例'实体不被漏掉，而它正是防超卖的锚点；代价是前期多花一两分钟区分 Item 与 Inventory 这类近义名词。
why_en: Starting from physical things guarantees you catch instance entities like Inventory, which is exactly what oversell prevention anchors on.
tradeoff: 自底向上从物理实体 vs 自顶向下从抽象实体
whenOtherWins: 如果系统里根本没有实物、只有纯数字账户余额，直接从抽象业务对象开始建模会更快。

termDefinitions.meaning: 微型配送中心，实物库存实际存放的地点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A DC is a Distribution Center, the physical site where inventory actually sits.

termDefinitions.meaning: 以资源为中心的 HTTP 接口风格，资源通常对应核心实体。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: REST stands for Representational State Transfer, an HTTP style whose resources map to core entities.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按分区键把一张大表水平切成多个物理片段，查询只落其中几片。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Partitioning splits one large table horizontally by a partition key so a query only touches a few shards.

scenario: 功能需求只有两条：按位置查可送达库存、一次下多商品订单。支付、搜索、退货都在线下范围，面试只有 45 分钟。
scenario_en: There are only two functional requirements: query deliverable stock by location, and place one order with several items. Payments, search, and returns are out of scope, and the interview is 45 minutes.
q: API 阶段应该把接口定义到什么程度？
q_en: How far should you take the API definition at this stage?
options: 只定两个接口，各带最少必要参数就往下走
把鉴权头、错误码和重试语义都先写完整再往下
先补上搜索、取消和退货接口的占位定义
跳过 API，直接从画服务组件框图开始
options_en: Define just two endpoints with the minimum parameters and move on.
Write out auth headers, error codes, and retry semantics in full before moving on.
Add placeholder definitions for search, cancellation, and returns first.
Skip the API and go straight to drawing the service boxes.
optionExplanations: 对。接口数量跟着功能需求走，两条需求就两个接口，够撑起后面的框图。
错。这些细节不改变任何架构判断，却会挤掉 deep dive 的时间。
错。线下范围的接口写了也不会被考察，等于主动给自己加时间成本。
错。API 是实体到组件之间的桥，跳过它后面画框图时输入输出对不上。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - endpoint count follows the functional requirements: two requirements, two endpoints, enough to anchor the diagram.
Wrong - none of that changes an architectural judgement, but it eats the deep-dive time.
Wrong - out-of-scope endpoints will not be assessed, so they are pure self-inflicted cost.
Wrong - the API bridges entities to components; skip it and the boxes have no agreed inputs or outputs.
why: 接口的粒度由功能需求条数决定，两条需求就两个接口；在参数细节上加码不改变任何架构判断，代价是挤掉后面深挖关键路径的时间。
why_en: Endpoint scope follows the functional requirements, so two requirements means two endpoints; extra parameter detail changes no architecture and costs you deep-dive time.
tradeoff: 最小接口快速通过 vs 前期把接口写到生产级完整
whenOtherWins: 如果这一轮就是 API 设计专项面试，鉴权、幂等键和错误语义反而是被考察的主体，必须写全。

termDefinitions.meaning: 应用编程接口，本题只需要 availability 查询和下单两个。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: API stands for Application Programming Interface; this problem only needs two of them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端带上的唯一键，让同一请求重试多次也只生效一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotency key is a unique client-supplied key so retrying the same request only takes effect once.

scenario: Senior 轮。HLD 已经画出 Availability、Orders、Nearby 三个服务和一个 Postgres，还剩大半时间。
scenario_en: A senior-level round. The HLD already shows the Availability, Orders, and Nearby services plus one Postgres, with most of the time still left.
q: 剩下的时间应该深挖哪两条路径？
q_en: Which two paths deserve the remaining time?
options: 下单事务的原子性，和读路径扩展
支付清结算流程，和骑手路径规划的排班算法
REST 命名规范，和库存表字段的正规化程度
把这三个服务再拆成十几个微服务的边界划分
options_en: The atomicity of the order transaction and scaling the read path.
The payment settlement flow and the driver routing and scheduling algorithm.
REST naming conventions and how far to normalize the inventory table columns.
How to split these three services into a dozen finer microservices.
optionExplanations: 对。这两条正好各被一条非功能需求钉住：强一致防超卖，和 20k QPS 读吞吐。
错。支付和配送调度都在线下范围，深挖它们等于答非所问。
错。这些是面试官默认你会的基础，senior 轮上应该高速带过。
错。需求规模不要求这种拆分，多出的服务边界只会新增跨服务一致性问题。
optionExplanations_en: Correct - each is pinned by one non-functional requirement: strong consistency against overselling, and 20k QPS of reads.
Wrong - payments and delivery scheduling are explicitly out of scope, so digging there answers the wrong question.
Wrong - the interviewer assumes you know these basics; at senior level you breeze past them.
Wrong - the requirements do not call for that split, and extra boundaries only add cross-service consistency problems.
why: 深挖的位置由非功能需求指定：强一致落在下单事务，20k QPS 落在 availability 读路径。代价是 HLD 必须快速带过，广度上的展示时间被压缩。
why_en: The non-functional requirements pick the deep dives for you: strong consistency on the order transaction and 20k QPS on the availability reads.
tradeoff: 把时间压在关键路径深挖 vs 均匀铺满每个组件
whenOtherWins: 如果是 mid-level 轮次，把两条路径的接口和数据模型完整覆盖，比深挖单点更贴近评分标准。
